description: Defines a template class ScopedGeneric for resource management with custom deleters, similar to unique_ptr but for non-pointer types, including traits for invalid values and free functions.

classes.name: ScopedGeneric
classes.description: A template class managing resources with custom traits, supporting move semantics, reset, release, and validation.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Releases current resource and assigns a new value.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps resources with another ScopedGeneric instance.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases ownership of the resource and returns it.

methods.name: receive
methods.description: Provides a pointer to the internal resource for out-parameter use.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a const reference to the managed resource.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the resource is valid (not equal to invalid value).

methods.name: get_traits
methods.description: Returns the traits object associated with the resource.
